behaviors.source_excerpt: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
behaviors.proposed_observable_outcome: When a member toggles the weekly email digest option in notification settings, the system sends or stops sending the weekly email digest according to the selected setting.

behaviors.source_excerpt: The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
behaviors.proposed_observable_outcome: After a member changes the weekly email digest setting and signs out, then signs back in, the notification settings still display the same digest preference they saved before signing out.

behaviors.source_excerpt: Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
behaviors.proposed_observable_outcome: When a member turns weekly email digests off, account-security messages continue to be sent to that member.

behaviors.source_excerpt: A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.
behaviors.proposed_observable_outcome: When a new member account is created, the member is not subscribed to weekly email digests unless and until the member enables that setting.
